dialog.name: hello
dialog.message: There you are! The service hatch behind me takes you back toward the rail line. That key will open both maintenance doors.
Keep the emerald. I have enough dangerous objects in my pockets already.

part.name: A Miner Supply Problem
part.info: Pedro is trapped in the abandoned Clearhaven mine. Recover ten small bombs from the storage level below him so he can clear the collapsed workings.

dialog.name: hello
dialog.message: Careful! The old entrance collapsed behind you, and half these supports are held together by habit.
I'm Pedro. I came looking for emeralds and found a mine that objects strongly to visitors.

dialog.name: mine
dialog.message: Clearhaven closed it more than a decade ago. They hid the entrance beneath the well, which was either clever planning or an unusually elaborate warning sign.

dialog.name: wayout
dialog.message: There's a maintenance hatch behind me and an old rail cart beyond it, but a collapse blocks the workings. I can clear it if you bring me ten small bombs from the storage level down that ladder.
I'd fetch them myself, but someone ought to remain here and look professionally concerned.

dialog.name: accept
dialog.message: The old safety latches have rusted through, so the bomb chests should open normally. Try not to test the merchandise.

dialog.name: hello
dialog.message: The storage level is down the ladder. I need ten small bombs, preferably all still shaped like bombs.

dialog.name: hello
dialog.message: You found the bombs! All ten, and none of them are ticking. You may be the best assistant I've had today.

dialog.name: reward
dialog.message: Sometimes I wish we could just create bombs out of thin air. Then I remember the walls, my eyebrows, and Clearhaven's insurance forms.
I'll handle the blasting. Take this service key and the emerald I found; the hatch behind me leads back to the maintenance tunnels, and the same key opens the gate to the rail cart.
